{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Duce''''' was a group of four [[Class-A cargo container]]s. The containers were located at a staging area for [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] and each contained parts for the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dispatched a pair of [[Missile Boat]]s to destroy all TIE Defenders in the area. The destruction of ''Duce'' group was considered a secondary objective. The operation was later used as a training exercise for Missile Boat pilots.
